pages.title: flavor_immersed_daily_argo-common.toml
pages.text: This is the main config. It is a COMMON config, read on the server side — editing it on a client changes nothing.$(br2)The mod actually reads the options listed on this page and the next; the rest are leftovers from the NeoForge template.

pages.title: Options that matter
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)giveGuideBookOnFirstJoin$() (default true): give each player one Nanshan Tutorial Scroll the first time they join. Each player receives it once.$(br)$(li)$(bold)giveFishingHandbookOnFirstJoin$() (default true): give each player one Catch Handbook the first time they join, also once per player. Both use advancement completion saved in the world, so rejoining never hands out a second copy.$(br)$(li)$(bold)mouseChunkLimit$() (default 2, range 1~64): how many field mice may exist in one chunk. Once reached, no more spawn there.$(br)$(li)$(bold)warnMissingParentMod$() (default true): remind players on login when the parent mod is missing.

pages.title: Natural spawning switches
pages.text: Four options decide whether this mod's animals appear on their own. All are $(bold)false$() by default — the intended source is spawn eggs bought online.$(br)$(li)$(bold)mouseNaturalSpawning$(): whether field mice spawn near mature crops.$(br)$(li)$(bold)landAnimalNaturalSpawning$(): whether poultry and livestock (duck, goose, quail, pigeon, turkey, bullfrog, bamboo rat) spawn on land.$(br)$(li)$(bold)freshwaterNaturalSpawning$(): whether freshwater animals spawn in non-ocean water.$(br)$(li)$(bold)saltwaterNaturalSpawning$(): whether saltwater animals spawn in ocean biomes.$(br2)These only gate natural spawning. Animals from spawn eggs, commands or fishing nets are unaffected; the mouse command override is covered under Admin Commands.

pages.title: Animal stats and trough
pages.text: Animal stat changes and trough behaviour are all tunable here, no source edit needed.$(br2)$(li)$(bold)animalDecayAmount$() (default 1, 0~10): how much satiety / thirst / cleanliness each 30-second decay tick removes.$(br)$(li)$(bold)animalRestoreAmount$() (default 1, 0~10): how much is regained every 5 s from drinking, standing in water or rain.$(br)$(li)$(bold)animalFeedSatiety$() (default 3) / $(bold)animalFeedMood$() (default 1): gained per hand-feed.$(br)$(li)$(bold)animalFeedCooldownTicks$() (default 20, 0~72000): minimum ticks between two hand-feeds of the same animal (20 ticks = 1 s); 0 disables the limit. Trough pacing is controlled separately by $(thing)troughEatIntervalTicks$().$(br)$(li)$(bold)animalWeightStepRatio$() (default 0.02, 0~1): share of the standard weight gained or lost every 30 s.$(br)$(li)$(bold)animalPoopChance$() (default 0.25): chance per independent manure attempt; 0 disables manure. It is no longer tied to satiety decay.$(br)$(li)$(bold)animalFlyBiteCleanLoss$() (default 5): extra cleanliness lost per tick while fly-bitten.

pages.title: Trough and keepable whitelist
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)troughNeedThreshold$() (default 5): an animal comes to the trough only when satiety / thirst is at or below this.$(br)$(li)$(bold)troughRestoreAmount$() (default 5): restored by one portion.$(br)$(li)$(bold)troughEatIntervalTicks$() (default 20, range 1~72000): ticks between two portions. Animals stay until full (10) or the trough is empty.$(br2)$(bold)The keepable whitelist is split by feed type$(), one entity id per line, e.g. $(thing)othermod:animal$():$(br)$(li)$(bold)extraFeedAnimals$() (default empty): extra animals that eat $(bold)Grass Feed$().$(br)$(li)$(bold)extraSeedFeedAnimals$() (default empty): extra animals that eat $(bold)Seed Feed$().$(br)$(li)$(bold)extraMeatFeedAnimals$() (default empty): extra animals that eat $(bold)Meat Feed$().$(br2)The three lists are independent: putting an animal in one list makes it accept only that feed, and it also gets the stat panel and trough attraction. Vanilla animals and most modded $(thing)Animal$() subclasses are already supported and do not need to be listed.

pages.title: Manure timing and spawn cap
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)animalPoopIntervalTicks$() (default 600): interval between independent manure attempts; 20 ticks = 1 second.$(br)$(li)Only animals actually fed by a player receive the manure eligibility marker. Trough feeding restores stats but does not grant eligibility.$(br)$(li)$(bold)animalChunkLimit$() (default 2): shared per-chunk natural-spawn cap for this mod's land and aquatic animals; 0 blocks these natural spawns. Field mice still use the separate $(thing)mouseChunkLimit$().$(br2)This cap neither removes existing animals nor blocks spawn eggs, commands or spawns from other mods.

pages.title: Safe to ignore
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)logDirtBlock$(), $(thing)magicNumber$(), $(thing)magicNumberIntroduction$() and $(thing)items$() come from the NeoForge example project. The mod $(bold)never reads$() them; any value is harmless.$(br2)They are kept only to keep the config layout stable, so leaving the defaults is fine.
